questions.q: Why isn't classic SQL Server Agent the right tool here?
options: SQL Server Agent was deprecated entirely in all SQL Server versions
Agent only works with dbo.Invoices, never dbo.Appointments
Agent requires a feature Azure never supports under any circumstance
OverlookClinicalDB is Azure SQL Database, a true PaaS database, where Agent doesn't run the way it does on a Managed Instance or VM
questions.explain: Classic SQL Server Agent's full on-server scheduling model doesn't apply the same way to Azure SQL Database specifically, which is why Elastic Jobs exists.

questions.q: What are the three pieces of an Elastic Job?
options: Backup, differential, and log file
Clustered index, nonclustered index, and included columns
Session, request, and connection
Job agent database, target group, and job
questions.explain: A job agent database stores job metadata and history, a target group defines which databases to run against, and a job is the script plus schedule.

questions.q: Why schedule the maintenance job for Sunday 2 AM rather than a weekday mid-morning?
options: Elastic Jobs can only run during overnight hours by design
Sunday is the only day Azure SQL Database allows ALTER INDEX
A REBUILD consumes real CPU/IO/log throughput, the same resources Billing and Scheduling need during business hours
It has no effect on resource contention at all
questions.explain: Running maintenance in a genuine low-traffic window avoids competing with the exact daytime load that caused this chapter's original problems.

questions.q: How do you confirm the scheduled job actually ran successfully?
options: Assume it worked because sp_add_job didn't return an error
Re-run the CREATE INDEX statement from Lesson 7
Check the Azure Portal's billing page
Query jobs.job_executions and confirm lifecycle shows Succeeded
questions.explain: jobs.job_executions is the real history view; creating a job is not the same as confirming it actually executed and succeeded.

questions.q: What does @target_group_name connect a job step to?
options: The specific index to rebuild, bypassing the script entirely
The named set of databases (defined via sp_add_target_group) the job step should run against
A single hard-coded server with no group concept at all
The login credentials used to authenticate the job
questions.explain: Target groups are defined once with sp_add_target_group/sp_add_target_group_member, then referenced by name in a job step.
